sentences.translation: 人生的短促

sentences.sentence: The danger lies in its unpredictability. Yet that may also be a reason for hope.
sentences.translation: 危险就在于其不可预测性，而这也可能是希望尚存的一个原因吧。

sentences.sentence: With the unpredictability of the volcano, authorities widened the danger zone around the mountain to 20 kilometers.
sentences.translation: 鉴于这一火山的不可预测性，印尼官员将“危险区域”扩大到方圆20公里。

sentences.sentence: While the West views democracy as an advantage since it can offer United States an institutional and bloodless process for renewal, Beijing views it as a source of irrationality and unpredictability.
sentences.translation: 尽管西方认为民主是一种优势，可以给美国提供一种制度上的、不流血的更新进程，但北京认为这是非理性和不可预测性的一个源头。

sentences.sentence: that magical evening we spent together
sentences.translation: 我们一起度过的那个美妙夜晚

sentences.sentence: A small storefront leads to an English-language school run by Disney.
sentences.translation: 一个小的店面通向由迪尼斯经营的英语语言学校。

sentences.sentence: That small number Wei quoted would presumably fund business with an online storefront and a small amount of goods, which could be sold for proceeds to pay the loan and buy more wares.
sentences.translation: 据推测，魏提到的少量自有资金或许将用来开设在线店面，以及购置少量货物，这些货物出售后的款项将用来继续提供贷款，以及购买更多货物。

sentences.sentence: Anybody can rent out a storefront and start their own church, and many people have done so.
sentences.translation: 任何人都可以租一间店面，开创自己的教会，而且也有很多人这样做了。

sentences.sentence: The refugees slept in makeshift tents at the side of the road.
sentences.translation: 逃难者睡在路边临时搭建的帐篷里。

sentences.sentence: the country’s economic plight
sentences.translation: 该国的经济困境

sentences.sentence: The giant cactus is the vegetable skycraper.
sentences.translation: 高大的仙人掌是植物界巨人。

sentences.sentence: A saguaro cactus stands tall amid a frenzy of lightning bolts in Arizona.
sentences.translation: 亚利桑那州，一株巨人柱仙人掌矗立在一团狂暴的闪电中。

sentences.sentence: The cactus… well, that will have to languish in the bathroom until next Spring.
sentences.translation: 仙人掌……，在春天到来前都应该把它放在浴室里。

sentences.sentence: a solemn expression
sentences.translation: 严肃的表情

sentences.sentence: Their faces suddenly grew solemn.
sentences.translation: 他们的脸突然变得严肃起来。

sentences.sentence: a solemn procession of mourners
sentences.translation: 庄重的送葬队伍

sentences.sentence: You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
sentences.translation: 你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

sentences.sentence: I forgot to bring my notes, so I had to improvise.
sentences.translation: 我忘了带笔记，只好临时发挥。

sentences.sentence: The plane ascended rapidly.
sentences.translation: 飞机迅速爬升。

translations.translation: 戏剧制作人, 玩杂耍的

sentences.sentence: He is the band’s best showman.
sentences.translation: 他是这支乐队中风头最盛的人。

sentences.sentence: All consultations are by appointment only .
sentences.translation: 就诊必须预约。

sentences.sentence: Prosecution and defence lawyers are expected to deliver closing arguments next week.
sentences.translation: 原告律师和被告律师下周将要作终结辩论。

translations.translation: 阿拉斯加人 a阿拉斯加的

sentences.sentence: But his obeying the ordinary driving commands of the Alaskan trail is no demonstration that he is yours. Any dog in Alaska would obey you as he obeyed.
sentences.translation: 他遵守阿拉斯加的驱赶命令并不意味着他就是你的狗，任何阿拉斯加的狗都会像他一样对你俯首贴耳。

sentences.sentence: But this crab also suffers from something of an identity crisis: Imported king crab is often misnamed Alaskan king crab, because most people think that's the name of the crab.
sentences.translation: 但这种蟹类也遭受了类似于身份危机的问题: 由于大多数人认为阿拉斯加帝王蟹就是这种螃蟹的名字，进口帝王蟹通常被这样误称。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 231 单元

legitimate
音标：英 /lɪ'dʒɪtɪmət/  美 /ləˈdʒɪtəmɪt/
adj. 合法的
短语：legitimate authority — 法定职权；合法权威
短语：legitimate interest — 合法权益；合法利益
短语：legitimate income — [经]正当收入
例句：That’s a perfectly legitimate question.
那个问题完全合乎情理。
例句：Most scientists believe it is legitimate to use animals in medical research.
大多数科学家认为用动物作医学研究是正当的。

plus
音标：英 /plʌs/  美 /plʌs/
prep. 加上 a正的
短语：plus one — (高尔夫球比赛中强者对弱者的)让一分，让一击
短语：plus or minus — 正负号；增减
短语：one plus one — 一加一
短语：cost plus — 成本加成；成本加利润
短语：plus side — 正侧；加侧
短语：plus sign — 加号
例句：Three plus six equals nine (3+6=9).
3 加6等于9。
例句：The total cost was $10,000, plus 14% interest.
全部费用是1万美元，外加14%的利息。

octopus
音标：英 /'ɒktəpəs/  美 /'ɑktəpəs/
n. 章鱼
例句：...plates of octopus.
…一盘盘章鱼肉。

temporal
音标：英 /'temp(ə)r(ə)l/  美 /'tɛmpərəl/
adj. 现世的, 暂时的
短语：temporal lobe — 颞叶
短语：temporal distribution — 时间分布
短语：temporal logic — 时序逻辑；时间逻辑
短语：temporal resolution — 时间分辨率；瞬时分辨力；瞬时清晰度
短语：temporal sequence — 时间序列；时间程序，时间层序
短语：temporal bone — [解]颞骨
短语：temporal correlation — 时间相关
短语：temporal dimension — 时间维度，时间因次
短语：temporal method — 暂行办法；时态法
短语：temporal coherence — 时间相干性
例句：the temporal character of human existence
人生的短促

unpredictability
音标：英 /ˌʌnprɪˌdɪktə'bɪlətɪ/  美 /ˌʌnprɪˌdɪktə'bɪlətɪ/
n. 不可预测性
例句：The danger lies in its unpredictability. Yet that may also be a reason for hope.
危险就在于其不可预测性，而这也可能是希望尚存的一个原因吧。
例句：With the unpredictability of the volcano, authorities widened the danger zone around the mountain to 20 kilometers.
鉴于这一火山的不可预测性，印尼官员将“危险区域”扩大到方圆20公里。
例句：While the West views democracy as an advantage since it can offer United States an institutional and bloodless process for renewal, Beijing views it as a source of irrationality and unpredictability.
尽管西方认为民主是一种优势，可以给美国提供一种制度上的、不流血的更新进程，但北京认为这是非理性和不可预测性的一个源头。

minimalist
音标：英 /'mɪnɪm(ə)lɪst/  美 /'mɪnɪmlɪst/
n. 最低限要求者

magical
音标：英 /'mædʒɪk(ə)l/  美 /'mædʒɪkl/
adj. 魔术的, 神奇的
例句：that magical evening we spent together
我们一起度过的那个美妙夜晚

storefront
音标：英 /'stɔːfrʌnt/  美 /'stɔr'frʌnt/
n. 店头, 店面
例句：A small storefront leads to an English-language school run by Disney.
一个小的店面通向由迪尼斯经营的英语语言学校。
例句：That small number Wei quoted would presumably fund business with an online storefront and a small amount of goods, which could be sold for proceeds to pay the loan and buy more wares.
据推测，魏提到的少量自有资金或许将用来开设在线店面，以及购置少量货物，这些货物出售后的款项将用来继续提供贷款，以及购买更多货物。
例句：Anybody can rent out a storefront and start their own church, and many people have done so.
任何人都可以租一间店面，开创自己的教会，而且也有很多人这样做了。

makeshift
音标：英 /'meɪkʃɪft/  美 /'mek'ʃɪft/
adj. 临时的
n. 临时替代物
例句：The refugees slept in makeshift tents at the side of the road.
逃难者睡在路边临时搭建的帐篷里。

plight
音标：英 /plaɪt/  美 /plaɪt/
n. 困境
例句：the country’s economic plight
该国的经济困境

cactus
音标：英 /'kæktəs/  美 /'kæktəs/
n. [植]仙人掌
例句：The giant cactus is the vegetable skycraper.
高大的仙人掌是植物界巨人。
例句：A saguaro cactus stands tall amid a frenzy of lightning bolts in Arizona.
亚利桑那州，一株巨人柱仙人掌矗立在一团狂暴的闪电中。
例句：The cactus… well, that will have to languish in the bathroom until next Spring.
仙人掌……，在春天到来前都应该把它放在浴室里。

solemn
音标：英 /'sɒləm/  美 /'sɑləm/
adj. 庄严的,严肃的
短语：solemn promise — 庄严承诺；誓言
短语：solemn ceremony — 隆重的典礼
例句：a solemn expression
严肃的表情
例句：Their faces suddenly grew solemn.
他们的脸突然变得严肃起来。
例句：a solemn procession of mourners
庄重的送葬队伍

reap
音标：英 /riːp/  美 /rip/
v. 收割, 收获
短语：reap the benefits of — 获得益处
例句：You'll soon begin to reap the benefits of being fitter.
你很快就会获得身体更健康带来的好处。

improvise
音标：英 /'ɪmprəvaɪz/  美 /'ɪmprəvaɪz/
v. 即兴创作
例句：I forgot to bring my notes, so I had to improvise.
我忘了带笔记，只好临时发挥。

ascend
音标：英 /ə'send/  美 /ə'sɛnd/
v. 攀登, 上升
例句：The plane ascended rapidly.
飞机迅速爬升。

showman
音标：英 /'ʃəʊmən/  美 /'ʃomən/
n. 戏剧制作人, 玩杂耍的
例句：He is the band’s best showman.
他是这支乐队中风头最盛的人。

summit
音标：英 /'sʌmɪt/  美 /'sʌmɪt/
n. 顶点, 最高阶层
短语：summit conference — 高峰会议；首脑会议

appointment
音标：英 /ə'pɒɪntm(ə)nt/  美 /ə'pɔɪntmənt/
n. 约会, 指定
短语：make an appointment — 约会，预约
短语：make an appointment with — 与某人约会
短语：have an appointment — 有约会
短语：appointment system — 委任制
短语：by appointment — 按照约定
短语：letter of appointment — 委任书，聘书
短语：appointment book — 记事簿；预约簿
例句：All consultations are by appointment only .
就诊必须预约。

lawyer
音标：英 /'lɔːjə; 'lɒɪə/  美 /'lɔjɚ/
n. 律师
短语：criminal lawyer — 刑事律师
例句：Prosecution and defence lawyers are expected to deliver closing arguments next week.
原告律师和被告律师下周将要作终结辩论。

Alaskan
n. 阿拉斯加人 a阿拉斯加的
例句：But his obeying the ordinary driving commands of the Alaskan trail is no demonstration that he is yours. Any dog in Alaska would obey you as he obeyed.
他遵守阿拉斯加的驱赶命令并不意味着他就是你的狗，任何阿拉斯加的狗都会像他一样对你俯首贴耳。
例句：But this crab also suffers from something of an identity crisis: Imported king crab is often misnamed Alaskan king crab, because most people think that's the name of the crab.
但这种蟹类也遭受了类似于身份危机的问题: 由于大多数人认为阿拉斯加帝王蟹就是这种螃蟹的名字，进口帝王蟹通常被这样误称。
